hooks.name: Keep spec traceability complete
hooks.description: When a test file is created or changed, make sure each test maps to an acceptance criterion so requirements stay covered.

action.prompt: A test file under test/ changed. Check that every test name carries a @covers <req>.<n> tag that points to a real acceptance criterion in .kiro/specs/testrazor/requirements.md. If any test is missing a tag or points to a criterion that does not exist, list the gaps and propose the correct tags. Do not edit unrelated tests.
